'''VibroSword Five''' was the callsign of the fifth member of [[VibroSword Squadron]], which flew for the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]]. During said battle, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified pilot (VibroSword Five)|pilot]] flew under the sign.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal" />
